title: Calibration signal profiler and per-task scorer adapters for FP8/INT8 rollouts
creator: Ava Chen
description: Background: As we push FP8/INT8 profiles into production, we observed subtle task-dependent regressions that are not captured by a single global metric. Existing evals report aggregate deltas (e.g. average perplexity or MMLU score) but miss distributional shifts on long-tail tasks and dialogue instruction fidelity. Goal: Build a lightweight calibration signal profiler plus a set of pluggable per-task scorer adapters that normalize metric outputs across precision profiles and provide actionable signals for rollouts. Scope: 1) Instrument runtime to emit calibration signals (activation distribution histograms, quantization clipping frequency, per-layer dynamic range drift) in a compact profile. 2) Implement scorer adapters for perplexity, MMLU-style multi-choice accuracy, BLEU/ROUGE for generation tasks, and a new Response-Fidelity scorer for instruction-following outputs that combines lexical overlap and semantic similarity. 3) Normalization layer that maps raw metric deltas to a unified Quality Delta score with configurable task weights and uncertainty bounds. 4) Small-sample calibration workflow (<=100 examples per task) and an automated gating rule for canary rollouts. Non-goals: Training new models, full-scale retraining, or changing default serving kernels. Acceptance criteria: - Runtime emits calibration profiles for 95% of sampled requests in canary window. - Scorer adapters return stable scores (CI < 5%) on repeated runs for the same dataset and profile. - Quality Delta correlates with manual QA labels (Spearman rho >= 0.6) on our validation suite for at least three canonical tasks (QA, summarization, multi-choice reasoning). - Canary gating export: pass/fail decision with confidence interval and top-5 contributing signals. Success metrics: - Reduce undetected post-rollout regressions by 70% compared to baseline dashboards. - Time-to-action (triage -> rollback or mitigation) reduced from median 12h to 2h for quantization-related incidents. Implementation plan: Week 1 (profiling hooks + schema), Week 2 (scorer adapters + test datasets), Week 3 (normalization and gating logic), Week 4 (integration with Console signals and docs). Deliverables: runtime profile schema (protobuf/JSON), scorer adapter library (py), calibration workflow runbook, Console widget for Quality Delta trends. Risks: small-sample variance, metric miscalibration across tasks, runtime telemetry overhead. Mitigations: sample stratification, bootstrapped CIs, lightweight histogram sketches, opt-in profiling, and fallbacks to baseline scoring.
